purdue_fid.name: Helen R. Johnson Hall Of Nursing

geometry_assessment.resolution: The single source ring is valid and has 984.01 m² area in the project local approximation. OSM way 117146488 independently gives 1005.86 m² and 0.876 m boundary Hausdorff difference, supporting the ring shape and indicating the stored Shape__Area=1701.02 is inconsistent with the geometry. The mesh uses the Purdue FID 218 vertices exactly; no area-based rescaling.

height_and_facade.height: 2018 3DEP LiDAR class-1 surface return median is 8.135 m above nearby class-2 ground; the main roof is modeled flat at the median. Purdue GIS reports 3 levels; floor-to-floor spacing remains a derived estimate.
height_and_facade.facade: Purdue's official historic building record lists Brick as a material, but supplies no image (embedded images array empty). An identity-matched Google Maps Street View panorama from September 2007 corroborates a horizontal upper-story window ribbon on the southwest-facing long facade. Eight modeled panes are a render proxy for the observed ribbon, not a measured bay count or dimension. No entrance, canopy, limestone band, lower-floor windows, or detailing is modeled because none is supported by available imagery/elevations.
height_and_facade.archive_lead: Purdue Archives catalogs Johnson Hall of Nursing in UA 149 J-K Slides, 1984–2000, Box 2, Folder 5, but the image file is not digitized in the public record; it cannot support additional claims.
height_and_facade.uncertainty: The 2007 panorama is secondary, low-resolution, and tree-obstructed; only the upper horizontal ribbon is used as corroborating facade evidence. Entrance and most facade details remain unverified.

time_scope_note: Purdue documents from 2023 proposed demolishing JNSN for the replacement Nursing and Pharmacy Education Building. This asset represents the legacy GIS identity and is not a model of the new replacement. Whether the old building remains on site at the present date is not asserted.
